package fixture_test

import (
 "context"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "testing"
 "time"

 "github.com/floegence/floret/v7/config"
 "github.com/floegence/floret/v7/florettest"
 "github.com/floegence/floret/v7/identity"
 "github.com/floegence/floret/v7/provider"
 "github.com/floegence/floret/v7/runtime"
 "github.com/floegence/floret/v7/storage"
 "github.com/floegence/floret/v7/tools"
)

// Run only in a blank module requiring the exact published v7.69.1.
func TestProduceReleasedCorrectionFailures(t *testing.T) {
 path:=os.Getenv("FLORET_FIXTURE_OUTPUT")
 if path=="" {t.Fatal("FLORET_FIXTURE_OUTPUT required")}
 if err:=os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path),0755);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 call:=func(id,name,args string)florettest.Step{return florettest.Step{Events:[]provider.Event{{Type:provider.EventToolCalls,ToolCalls:[]provider.ToolCall{{ID:id,Name:name,Args:args}}},{Type:provider.EventDone,Reason:"tool_calls"}}}}
 steps:=[]florettest.Step{}
 for i:=0;i<3;i++ {
  steps=append(steps,call(fmt.Sprint("bad-",i),"terminal.exec",`{"yield_time_ms":1}`))
  if i<2 {steps=append(steps,call(fmt.Sprint("good-",i),"terminal.exec",`{"yield_ms":1}`))}
 }
 steps=append(steps,call("control-confirmed","terminal.exec",`{"yield_ms":1}`))
 for i:=0;i<3;i++ {steps=append(steps,call(fmt.Sprint("ask-",i),runtime.CoreControlAskUser,`{}`))}
 gateway:=florettest.NewScriptedGateway(provider.Identity{Provider:"compatibility",Model:"fake",StateCompatibilityKey:"compatibility"},provider.Capabilities{Reasoning:provider.ReasoningUnsupported},steps...)
 executions:=0
 tool:=tools.Define[map[string]any](tools.Definition{Name:"terminal.exec",ReadOnly:true,InputSchema:tools.StrictObject(map[string]any{"yield_ms":tools.Integer("yield")},[]string{"yield_ms"}),Permission:tools.PermissionSpec{Mode:tools.PermissionAllow}},nil,nil,func(context.Context,tools.Invocation[map[string]any])(tools.Result,error){executions++;return tools.Result{Text:"CONFIRMED_RELEASED_RESULT"},nil})
 host,err:=runtime.Open(t.Context(),runtime.Options{Storage:storage.SQLite(path),IDSource:florettest.NewIDSource(florettest.IDSourceOptions{ThreadIDs:[]identity.ThreadID{"ordinary","control","fork","nested"},TurnIDs:[]identity.TurnID{"ordinary-turn","control-turn"},RunIDs:[]identity.RunID{"ordinary-run","control-run"}})})
 if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 service,err:=host.ThreadService(runtime.AgentFactoryFunc(func(context.Context,runtime.AgentRequest)(*runtime.Agent,error){return runtime.NewAgent(config.AgentConfig{Profile:config.AgentProfile{ID:"fixture",Name:"Compatibility"},SystemPrompt:"Inspect.",Context:config.ContextPolicy{ContextWindowTokens:config.DefaultContextWindowTokens}},gateway,runtime.WithAgentTools(tool),runtime.WithAgentEffectAuthorization(runtime.EffectAuthorizationGateFunc(func(ctx context.Context,req runtime.EffectAuthorizationRequest,effect runtime.AuthorizedEffect)(runtime.EffectDispatchResult,error){return effect(ctx,runtime.EffectAuthorizationProof{EffectAttemptID:req.EffectAttemptID,RequestFingerprint:req.RequestFingerprint,ThreadID:req.ThreadID,TurnID:req.TurnID,RunID:req.RunID,ToolCallID:req.ToolCallID,PolicyRevision:"fixture",AuditReference:"fixture",AuditHash:"fixture",AuthorizedAt:time.Now().UTC()})})))}))
 if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 for _,id:=range []string{"ordinary","control"} {
  view,err:=service.Create(t.Context(),runtime.CreateThreadInput{RequestKey:runtime.RequestKey("create-"+id)});if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  if view.ThreadID.String()!=id{t.Fatal(view.ThreadID)}
  if _,err:=service.Send(t.Context(),runtime.SendInput{ThreadID:view.ThreadID,RequestKey:runtime.RequestKey("send-"+id),Input:runtime.UserInput{Text:"Retain the confirmed result and inspect."}});err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  deadline:=time.Now().Add(10*time.Second)
  for {
   failed,err:=service.View(t.Context(),view.ThreadID);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
   if failed.Activity==runtime.ThreadActivityIdle&&failed.LastOutcome!=nil {
    if failed.Failure==nil||*failed.LastOutcome!=runtime.TurnOutcomeFailed{t.Fatalf("not failed: %+v",failed)}
    want:=runtime.ThreadTurnFailureToolDispatch;if id=="control"{want=runtime.ThreadTurnFailureControlError}
    if failed.Failure.Code!=want{t.Fatalf("failure=%+v",failed.Failure)}
    break
   }
   if time.Now().After(deadline){t.Fatal("did not settle")}
   time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
  }
 }
 for _,id:=range []identity.ThreadID{"ordinary","fork"}{if _,err:=service.Fork(t.Context(),runtime.ForkThreadInput{SourceThreadID:id,RequestKey:runtime.RequestKey("fork-"+id.String())});err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}}
 if executions!=3||len(gateway.Requests())!=9 {t.Fatalf("executions=%d requests=%d",executions,len(gateway.Requests()))}
 if err:=host.Shutdown(t.Context());err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
}
